formatting.sitecustomize_source:
import black
import black.concurrency


def serial_reformat_many(*, sources, fast, write_back, mode, report, workers=None,
                         no_cache=False, cache_dir=None):
    for source in sorted(sources):
        black.reformat_one(source, fast, write_back, mode, report,
                           no_cache=no_cache, cache_dir=cache_dir)


black.concurrency.reformat_many = serial_reformat_many
